I am an old woman of 63 years, and on this small piece of land I plant together with other crops to feed my family. I have no money to buy fertilizer from the shop, but I put the manure from my few animals and the kitchen ash on the soil. I use the seeds I saved from last harvest, as my mother and grandmother did, and I work the land myself with my hoe because hiring people costs money I do not have.
